comparison: Incremental refinement of concurrent PR #140; original-main indexed-shortcut gains are not claimed as this contribution.
final_source_semantics: Relative to PR #140, the final source preserves eager source-key validation, skips a separate index probe for a singleton, and skips an already-failed immutable hint in the fallback scan. Unsupported source authorities retain the baseline fast rejection. The singleton deduplication fast return performs no item normalization. Lazy source preparation was rejected in the separately retained earlier cohort.
limitations: Hosted Linux x86_64 Swift 6.4 component measurements; these do not establish macOS, full-app, UI, disk persistence, or playback performance.
The host/toolchain differs from the earlier local Swift 6.3.2 exploratory studies; cohorts are not pooled.
Eight balanced pairs are retained without trimming. No observation was below the 100 ms target.
Supporting Core code is shared and exact; only the PlaybackSessionStore prefix through the record and protocol is compiled, as disclosed in the runner.
Ten compiled binary hashes are runner-recorded in the manifest. Compiled binaries were not included in the hosted artifact and were not independently rehashed by this audit.
The frozen tests.json reports only the final module summary; all raw logs prove 43 tests in 7 suites across two module runs per configuration, as detailed in test_summary_correction.
The artifact ZIP SHA256 was independently checked against the supplied retrieval receipt; this audit made no additional GitHub API request.
performance_decision: PASS retained single-absent target, with all 25 controls below the paired 10 percent plus 5 microsecond investigation threshold. Applies to the final eager-source component on this Linux runner.
